messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: route-proxy > 95th latency increase and 3xx surge on prod (alert: route-proxy-3xx-latency-burst). PD incident id: PDN12345. Paging on-call.

alex: acked in PD. I’m on it — checking dashboards and recent deploys.

sana: seeing a short spike in 3xx on the canary pool (canary-us-west-2). Requests up ~3x for ~60s. No obvious error traces in app logs yet.

maria: tagging infra — could be a throttling/connection issue to backend auth service. grabbing proxy logs.

alex: pulling proxy logs. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T12:05:41Z proxy[pid=1234] INFO upstream_status=302 path=/v1/embed user=svc-canary
2026-03-15T12:06:07Z proxy[pid=1234] WARN slow_kv_lookup duration_ms=480
```
looks like a transient backend latency causing redirects/responses to shift to 3xx?

sana: checking autoscaler and node metrics. No scale events triggered. CPU steady. Network egress on that AZ spiked briefly. Could be degraded route to auth. pinging infra team.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PDN12345 acknowledged by alex. Escalation paused.

alex: quick mitigation — routing policy switch: moving canary traffic off canary-us-west-2 to stable pool for next minute. Deploy console command: 
```bash
redwood route update --service route-proxy --remove-canary canary-us-west-2 --dry-run=false
```
applied.

maria: verified proxy route change via `curl -sS https://rt-console/api/routes | jq '.pools'` — canary pool traffic dropped to 0%. 3xx rate returning to baseline.

sana: infra reports a short NAT gateway glitch in us-west-2 that correlated with the window. looks like a transient cloud infra issue, not our code.

incident-bot: PDN12345 auto-resolved (alert cleared) after 2m 24s.

alex: thanks. No customer-facing errors reported in Sentry for the window. I'll post a brief note to #incidents and flag for a quick blameless follow-up.

maria: leaving a pinned snippet in this thread w/ commands used and the log excerpt. recommend we add a synthetic check for 3xx regression after routing changes.

sana: agreed. I'll add an internal heartbeat alert to detect short NAT egress anomalies and follow up with cloud provider ticket.

alex: reassigning PD to sev-triage for a light RCA. PD closed by alex. :white_check_mark:

maria: moving to post-incident review doc, will include timeline + mitigations (routing switch). No action required for customers.

incident-bot: Note: this thread will be archived in 7 days.
